class.name: CrashCatch
class.brief_description: Graceful crash capture, reporting, and deferred upload for Godot games.
class.description: CrashCatch installs native crash handlers (chained with any existing ones) so that a crash in a shipped game writes a crash report to [code]user://crash_reports/[/code]. On the next launch the report is enriched (log tail, system info) and, if configured, uploaded to a private analyzer endpoint that symbolicates the native stack using the build's separate debug symbols. The handlers work even in [code]template_release[/code] exports, where the engine's own crash handler is compiled out. Exposed to GDScript as the global singleton [code]CrashCatch[/code].

method.name: crash_here
method.description: Test API. Deliberately dereferences a null pointer to trigger a crash, so the capture/upload pipeline can be verified. Disabled unless [code]crash_catch/debug/enable_test_api[/code] is true.

method.name: crash_via_abort
method.description: Test API. Calls [code]abort()[/code]. Disabled unless [code]crash_catch/debug/enable_test_api[/code] is true.

method.name: crash_with_signal
method.description: Test API. Raises the given POSIX signal number. Disabled unless [code]crash_catch/debug/enable_test_api[/code] is true.

method.name: flush_pending_uploads
method.description: Attempts to upload all pending crash reports now. Returns the number successfully uploaded.

method.name: force_write_test_report
method.description: Writes a complete synthetic crash report without crashing the process, then attempts upload if enabled. Always available. Returns the report's [code]user://[/code] path.

method.name: get_crash_report_dir
method.description: Returns the [code]user://crash_reports[/code] directory where reports are written.

method.name: get_pending_reports
method.description: Returns the paths of crash reports that have not yet been uploaded.

method.name: get_last_crash_zip
method.description: Returns the path of the most recently produced sendable crash [code].zip[/code] (report + log + READ_ME), or an empty string if none. Use this to point the player at a file to email you. See [code]crash_catch/manual/contact[/code].

method.name: get_pending_zips
method.description: Returns the paths of all crash [code].zip[/code] bundles currently in the report directory.

method.name: zip_report
method.description: Bundles a specific report [code].json[/code] (plus the log and a READ_ME) into a sibling [code].zip[/code] on demand and returns its path. Emits [signal crash_zip_ready].

signal.name: crash_captured
signal.description: Emitted on launch for each crash report recovered from a previous crashed run.

signal.name: report_uploaded
signal.description: Emitted after a report is successfully uploaded.

signal.name: upload_failed
signal.description: Emitted when a report upload fails.

signal.name: crash_zip_ready
signal.description: Emitted when a sendable crash [code].zip[/code] has been written (on launch for a recovered crash, or after [method zip_report]). [b]Note:[/b] the launch-time emission happens during module init, before your scene's [code]_ready[/code] runs, so a connection made in [code]_ready[/code] will miss it. To show a "please send this" prompt at startup, call [method get_last_crash_zip] or [method get_pending_zips] in [code]_ready[/code] instead. The signal is reliable for on-demand [method zip_report] calls.
